breakdown.description: Output requests solution at T=2.1 but the Domain section specifies t in [0, 2].
breakdown.reason: The generated specification consistently uses T=2.0 throughout, matching the ground truth. The incorrect T=2.1 from the incomplete prompt was corrected to T=2.0 in the compute step ('Compute u(x,T=2.0)'), in the time step calculation ('so that the final time T=2.0 is hit exactly'), and in the reporting ('Print min(u), max(u), and the discrete L2 norm sqrt(sum(u^2)*dx) at T=2.0').
